findings.title: Get Note and List Notes should be one list action with a mode
findings.location: Actions › Get Note and Actions › List Notes
findings.issue: Two actions read notes, one by ID and one as a list. Users must pick between them, and neither action has a mode field.

evidence.ref: Get Note › V1 › perform (GET /notes/{id}) and List Notes › V1 › perform (GET /notes)
evidence.quote: two separate actions; neither inputjson has a mode field
Always combine listing ("List All"), searching (by specific identifiers), "Search by ID", and "Advance Search" (if supported) into a single LIST action using a Mode selector.

fix.content: Add a Mode dropdown (List All / Search by ID) to List Notes. Show the note dropdown only for Search by ID (GET /notes/{id}, with the 404 handling from F-002), and Updated After, Include Deleted, Enable Pagination and Pagination Options only for List All. Then retire Get Note.

findings.avoid: Do not delete Get Note once it is published or used in flows; it is unpublished with 0 runs today, so merging now is non-breaking. Keep the key note_id.
findings.expectedResult: One action reads notes both ways.
findings.verify: Dry run each mode: list all, search by an existing ID, search by an unknown ID (expect 'No data found.').

findings.title: Get Note, Get Note Summary and Get Note Transcript throw on 404
findings.issue: When the note, summary or transcript is not found, the action fails with an error instead of returning a 'No data found.' message, so a flow stops. The plug's own notes say Alt answers 404 until a summary or transcript is ready, and the New Recording Ended sample shows summary_status 'pending' at that moment, so a flow that calls Get Note Summary right after that trigger is likely to hit it (not verified against Alt's docs).

evidence.ref: Get Note Summary › V1 › perform line 6
evidence.quote: const response = await axios.get(`https://public-api.altalt.io/v1/notes/${encodeURIComponent(note_id)}/summary`);  (no 404 handling; the catch only calls errorComponent)
The perform code should handle 404 (record not found) gracefully.

findings.avoid: Apply the same wrapper to the /summary and /transcript URLs. Do not swallow other statuses (401, 403, 429): rethrow them so errorComponent shows the real message.
findings.expectedResult: An unknown or not-yet-ready note returns a message with success: true and the flow carries on.
findings.verify: Run each action with a deleted or unknown note ID and, if possible, a note whose summary is still pending.

findings.title: List Notes treats a mapped "false" as true
findings.location: List Notes › V1 › perform › line 18 (include_deleted) and line 6 (enable_pagination); inputjson › pagination_options › visibilityCondition
findings.issue: In custom mapping mode a Yes/No toggle becomes a text field, and the help tells users to type true or false. The code tests the value for truthiness, so the text "false" counts as true: deleted notes are returned although the user said No, and 'fetch all pages' is ignored.

evidence.ref: List Notes › V1 › perform lines 6 and 18
evidence.quote: const paginate = enable_pagination ?? true;  /  include_deleted: include_deleted ? true : undefined  (customHelp: "Enter true to include deleted notes, or false to return only active notes.")

evidence.ref: dh-Input-fields-json-builder.md › Special Note: Custom Mapping Behavior (Dropdown, Multiselect & Boolean)
evidence.quote: When the user switches to custom mapping, the field becomes a plain text `string` input field.

findings.avoid: Do not rename the keys include_deleted or enable_pagination. Keep the default of 'paginate on' when the field is empty.
findings.expectedResult: Typing false behaves like choosing No.
findings.verify: Run with the toggle set to No, with the text false mapped in, and empty; compare whether deleted notes appear and how many pages return.

findings.title: Connection label uses an extra typed name instead of the masked API key
findings.location: Connection › V1 › authfields › account_name; connectionlabelkey / connectionlabelvalue / isconnectionlabelmasked
findings.issue: The test call is a list endpoint (GET /notes), so the rules want the label to come from the API key field with masking on. Instead users must type a separate required Account Name, which Alt's API does not need, and the label is not masked.

evidence.quote: connectionlabelkey: "account", connectionlabelvalue: "context.authData?.account_name", isconnectionlabelmasked: false; testcode: GET https://public-api.altalt.io/v1/notes?limit=1

If the Test API is any other endpoint (lists like `/brands`, `/workspaces`, `/teams`, or `/status`, `/ping`), never map the label from its response ... Use the API key auth field with masking on: `connectionlabelkey: "API Key"`, `connectionlabelvalue: "context.authData?.<api key field key>"`, `_connectionlabelvalue: "${context.authData?.<api key field key>}"`, `isconnectionlabelmasked: true`.

fix.content: Set connectionlabelkey to "API Key", connectionlabelvalue to "context.authData?.api_key", _connectionlabelvalue to "${context.authData?.api_key}" and isconnectionlabelmasked to true, then remove the account_name field.

findings.avoid: Removing a field is a breaking change: if any user has already connected, COPY the connection to a new version instead of editing it, and never rename the key api_key.
findings.expectedResult: Users enter only the API key; the saved connection shows it masked.
findings.verify: Create a connection with the new version and check the label in the connection list.
